desc:
Daniel SoundGuard Powered by KGM Suppressors utilize cutting-edge gas-flow dynamics that eliminate over-gassing and direct most gasses forward, not back in a shooter’s face. So, you experience less toxic gas blowback and can concentrate on putting more shots on target. State-of-the-art KGM technology significantly lowers impulse noise levels, protecting against hearing loss, while a patented baffle stack and proprietary coating on internal parts reduce a firearm’s flash signature to virtually zero. Patented gas-flow pathing stabilizes rounds to ensure extreme accuracy with minimal point-of-impact shift.
The SG-30TiL is compatible with .223 through 300 PRC caliber firearms and features an adjustable-port endcap that provides maximum recoil reduction regardless of a firearm’s caliber or configuration. It is constructed of extremely lightweight and durable titanium, so you don’t have to baby it, and it won’t weigh down your barrel. It attaches/detaches in seconds via an included
titanium adapter utilizing the HUB standard 1.375-24 UNS, which provides secure attachment while adding minimal length and allowing for the use of a variety of other muzzle attachments, such as Keymo and ASR. Every SG-30TiL suppressor is stamped with the Daniel name, which means it’s backed with a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.
